utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you got a few book options in mind, or should I suggest some?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks — I’m a bit scatterbrained today. I think we were reading the mystery book, but I’d be happy to hear your suggestions too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can suggest a few—do you want mystery, something lighter, or a mix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ve been hearing it’s still "The Marrow Thieves" on Thursday at 7 at the community center, so I’m in unless there’s a change.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That matches what I have — Thursday at 7 at the community center for The Marrow Thieves. If anything changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Hana — I’ll plan on that and keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still don’t have the time or place yet, so let’s wait until it’s confirmed before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it’s still on this week? I just want confirmation before I go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet, so I don’t want to guess—let’s wait for a confirmed time and place before heading out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re on "The Marrow Thieves," and it looks like Thursday at 7 at the community center. I’m still keeping an eye out in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks for the update—Thursday at 7 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for any last-minute changes and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at the cafe after pickup still works for me. Eli, do you want to suggest a book idea, or should I send one over to Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at the cafe works for me. If you have a book in mind, send it over to Rosa and I’ll bring my notes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send Rosa a book idea soon and keep it after pickup. Looking forward to your notes, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet — have you got any favorites in mind, or should I check with everyone and find a time that works?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got a few favorites in mind — I can send them over, and you can check with everyone about a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect — send them over and I’ll check with everyone about a time that works for the group.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Next Thursday at 7 PM at my place—I'll send the book title and details right over!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good to me — I’ve got next Thursday at 7 at your place. Just send the book title and any details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll text you the book title and the rest of the details tonight. Really glad you’re coming!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m in for a short mystery. Just send me the title and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the title as soon as I pick it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll look out for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — could you check the list and send me the title? I’ll keep the book club notes updated for Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll check the list and send you the title for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — I’ll update the notes as soon as you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still checking on the new novel and meeting time, Mara — I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — no rush at all. Same plan works for me: bring a chapter you liked and we’ll keep it easy over tea.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds perfect, Mara — I’ll keep asking around and let you know as soon as I have the novel and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check with the others about the next book and meeting time, then I’ll let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you checking — just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll ask the others and update you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, right — the book club. Do you know which book we’re reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on Cleo to check the list, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear. I’ll bring a chapter I liked either way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — thanks, Ira. I’ll be glad to hear what Cleo says, and I’d enjoy the chapter you liked either way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still checking on the new novel and meeting time—I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — appreciate it. I’ll bring a chapter I liked and keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the novel and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d like to check the next meeting time first, if that’s all right.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’m still watching for any updates on the book club time and place, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind, thank you. I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — quick update: the book club is now Thursday at the cafe. If you have a book idea, send it my way and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa — Thursday at the cafe works for me. I’ll send over a book idea soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — sounds great. I’ll watch for your suggestion and add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ve been hearing it’s still *The Marrow Thieves* on Thursday at 7 at the community center. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good to me — Thursday at 7 at the community center works, and I’ll bring a chapter I liked. See you then over tea.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll pass that along and see everyone Thursday at 7 over tea.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right — The Dutch House this week. Thanks, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll see you there, and I’ll send the next pick soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — thanks for sending the next pick!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, book club — sorry, I’m a bit scatterbrained today. I think it’s Tuesday at 4:30 after pickup, and we’re reading the mystery book.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks — Tuesday at 4:30 after pickup works, and the mystery book sounds great. I’ll pass the details along so everyone’s in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Quinn — I really appreciate it. I’m glad we’ve got it sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll check the list and let you know what we’re reading for book club this month.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll ask around too and see what works best for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll check the list and keep you posted on the book club pick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — happy to help with the book club. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — do you know what book we’re reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure offhand, but I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at the cafe still works for me after pickup—what time were you thinking, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7 works for me. I’ll confirm the book club details and send them over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7 works for me too—thanks, Leo. I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention the book club plan to the others and see who’s in for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Let’s confirm who’s in first, then we can settle the next book.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check who’s in and then we can decide on the next book and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I might be mixing it up, but I think it’s the usual time and place. I can double-check with Hana if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure? I’d rather have Hana confirm it before I show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, fair — I’ll check with Hana and make sure before you head over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll check with everyone first and then we can lock in the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Mina. Just let me know what works for everyone, and I’ll help set it all up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll check in with everyone about the book pick and availability, then I’ll circle back.
